arxiv-2006-10902.creator: Brent Belland 1,5 {}^{\text{1,5}}, James Gunn 2, Dan Reiley 1, Judith Cohen 1, Evan Kirby 1, Antonio Cesar de Oliveira 3, Ligia Souza de Oliveira 3, Mitsuko Roberts 1, and Michael Seiffert 1,4 {}^{\text{1,4}}
arxiv-2006-10902.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Brent Belland 1,5 {}^{\text{1,5}}, James Gunn 2, Dan Reiley 1, Judith Cohen 1, Evan Kirby 1, Antonio Cesar de Oliveira 3, Ligia Souza de Oliveira 3, Mitsuko Roberts 1, and Michael Seiffert 1,4 {}^{\text{1,4}}. Focal ratio degradation (FRD), the increase of light’s focal ratio between the input into an optical fiber and the output, is important to characterize for astronomical spectrographs due to its effects on throughput and the point spread function.

arxiv-2202-03733.title: Phase retrieval of entire functions and its implications for Gabor phase retrieval
arxiv-2202-03733.creator: Matthias Wellershoff
arxiv-2202-03733.description: Abstract We characterise all pairs of finite order entire functions whose magnitudes agree on two arbitrary lines in the complex plane by means of the Hadamard factorisation theorem. Building on this, we also characterise all pairs of second order entire functions whose magnitudes agree on infinitely many equidistant parallel lines.

arxiv-2203-00728.title: FHEBench: Benchmarking Fully Homomorphic Encryption Schemes
arxiv-2203-00728.creator: Lei Jiang, Lei Ju
arxiv-2203-00728.description: Abstract Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) emerges one of the most promising solutions to privacy-preserving computing in an untrusted cloud. FHE can be implemented by various schemes, each of which has distinctive advantages, i.e., some are good at arithmetic operations, while others are efficient when implementing Boolean logic operations.

arxiv-2209-07468.title: Phenomenological formula for Quantum Hall resistivity based on the Riemann zeta function
arxiv-2209-07468.creator: André LeClair
arxiv-2209-07468.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by André LeClair. We propose a formula constructed out of elementary functions that captures many of the detailed features of the transverse resistivity ρ x ​ y \rho_{xy} for the integer quantum Hall effect. It is merely a phenomenological formula in the sense that it is not based on any transport calculation for a specific class of physical models involving electrons in a disordered landscape, thus, whether a physical model exists which realizes this resistivity remains an open question.

arxiv-2210-05451.title: Enabling ISP-less Low-Power Computer Vision
arxiv-2210-05451.creator: Gourav Datta, Zeyu Liu, Zihan Yin, Linyu Sun, Akhilesh R. Jaiswal, Peter A. Beerel
arxiv-2210-05451.description: Abstract Current computer vision (CV) systems use an image signal processing (ISP) unit to convert the high resolution raw images captured by image sensors to visually pleasing RGB images. Typically, CV models are trained on these RGB images and have yielded state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on a wide range of complex vision tasks, such as object detection.

arxiv-2212-01884.title: Melody transcription via generative pre-training
arxiv-2212-01884.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . Despite the central role that melody plays in music perception, it remains an open challenge in MIR to reliably detect the notes of the melody present in an arbitrary music recording. A key challenge in melody transcription is building methods which can handle broad audio containing any number of instrument ensembles and musical styles—existing strategies work well for some melody instruments or styles but not all.

arxiv-2405-20267.title: Auto-Arena:Automating LLM Evaluations with Agent Peer Battles and Committee Discussions
arxiv-2405-20267.creator: Ruochen Zhao, Wenxuan Zhang, Yew Ken Chia, Weiwen Xu, Deli Zhao, Lidong Bing
arxiv-2405-20267.description: Abstract As LLMs continuously evolve, there is an urgent need for a reliable evaluation method that delivers trustworthy results promptly. Currently, static benchmarks suffer from inflexibility and unreliability, leading users to prefer human voting platforms like Chatbot Arena. However, human evaluations require significant manual effort.

arxiv-2408-00879.title: Exceptional points in SSH-like models with hopping amplitude gradient
arxiv-2408-00879.creator: David S. Simon, Christopher R. Schwarze, Abdoulaye Ndao, Alexander V. Sergienko
arxiv-2408-00879.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by David S. Simon, Christopher R. Schwarze, Abdoulaye Ndao, Alexander V. Sergienko. The Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) system is a popular model for exploring topological insulators and topological phases in one dimension. Recent interest in exceptional points has led to re-examination of non-Hermitian generalizations of many physical models, including the SSH model. In such non-Hermitian systems, singular points called exceptional points (EPs) appear that are of interest for applications in super-resolution sensing systems and topological lasers.

arxiv-2411-15826.title: Expert-elicitation method for non-parametric joint priors using normalizing flows
arxiv-2411-15826.creator: Florence Bockting https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0924-6413, Stefan T. Radev https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6702-9559, Paul-Christian Bürkner https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5765-8995
arxiv-2411-15826.description: Abstract We propose an expert-elicitation method for learning non-parametric joint prior distributions using normalizing flows. Normalizing flows are a class of generative models that enable exact, single-step density evaluation and can capture complex density functions through specialized deep neural networks. Building on our previously introduced simulation-based framework, we adapt and extend the methodology to accommodate non-parametric joint priors.

arxiv-2506-14042.description: Abstract We show how several graph problems (e.g., vertex-cover, independent-set, k k -coloring) can be encoded into CNF using only 𝒪 ⁡ ( | V | 2 / lg ⁡ | V | ) \mathcal{O}(|V|^{2}/\lg|V|) many clauses, as opposed to the Ω ⁡ ( | V | 2 ) \Omega(|V|^{2}) constraints used by standard encodings.

arxiv-2506-22458.title: A Portable and Cost-Effective System for Real-Time Air Quality Monitoring and Environmental Impact Assessment
arxiv-2506-22458.creator: 1 st S M Minhazur Rahman, 2 nd Md. Amrin Ibna Hasnath, 3 rd Rifatul Islam, 4 th Ahmed Faizul Haque Dhrubo, 5 th Mohammad Abdul Qayum
arxiv-2506-22458.description: Abstract Air pollution remains a major global issue that seriously impacts public health, environmental quality, and ultimately human health. To help monitor problem, we have created and constructed a low-cost, real-time, portable air quality monitoring system using cheap sensors. The system measures critical pollutants PM2.5, PM10, and carbon monoxide (CO), and environmental variables such as temperature and humidity.

arxiv-2507-12698.title: Pixel Perfect MegaMed: A Megapixel-Scale Vision-Language Foundation Model for Generating High Resolution Medical Images
arxiv-2507-12698.creator: Zahra TehraniNasab, Amar Kumar, Tal Arbel
arxiv-2507-12698.description: Abstract Medical image synthesis presents unique challenges due to the inherent complexity and high-resolution details required in clinical contexts. Traditional generative architectures such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) or Variational Auto Encoder (VAEs) have shown great promise for high-resolution image generation but struggle with preserving fine-grained details that are key for accurate diagnosis.

arxiv-2510-06761.title: Evolving and Executing Research Plans via Double-Loop Multi-Agent Collaboration
arxiv-2510-06761.creator: Zhi Zhang, Yan Liu, Zhejing Hu, Gong Chen, Sheng-hua Zhong, Jiannong Cao
arxiv-2510-06761.description: Abstract Automating the end-to-end scientific research process poses a fundamental challenge: it requires both evolving high-level plans that are novel and sound, and executing these plans correctly amidst dynamic and uncertain conditions. To address this bilevel challenge, we propose a novel Double-Loop Multi-Agent (DLMA) framework to solve the given research problem automatically.

pmc-11975514.title: 内皮祖细胞与慢性阻塞性肺疾病：从基础研究到临床应用
pmc-11975514.creator: 雪 何, 慧卉 曾, 燕 陈
pmc-11975514.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). 慢性阻塞性肺疾病是一种以持续气流受限为特征的慢性肺部疾病，血管内皮功能障碍是其重要的发病机制之一。内皮祖细胞(endothelial progenitor cells，EPCs)作为一类具有血管修复与再生能力的祖细胞，在慢性阻塞性肺疾病的病理进程中起重要作用。慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者的外周血中EPCs数量显著减少、功能显著下降，且与疾病严重程度、肺功能下降、急性加重、营养状况及合并症等因素密切相关。吸烟、尼古丁、电子香烟及细颗粒物(particulate matter 2.5，PM2.5)等环境因素可明显损伤EPCs的功能并减少其数量，其作用机制可能涉及血管内皮生长因子/血管内皮生长因子受体、趋化因子12/趋化因子受体4信号通路及多种细胞因子的调控。此外，动物实验显示，气管内移植EPCs可明显改善肺气肿模型的肺功能及病理改变，提示靶向EPCs可能成为慢性阻塞性肺疾病治疗的关键策略之一。通过探究EPCs的动员、归巢与功能障碍的具体分子机制，探讨EPCs临床转化应用的有效性与安全性，有望为慢性阻塞性肺疾病等慢性肺部疾病的治疗提供新的思路。 慢性阻塞性肺疾病(以下简称“慢阻肺”)是一种具有高度异质性的肺部疾病，其临床特征包括咳嗽、咳痰、呼吸困难等慢性呼吸道症状，导致不可逆的肺损伤和气流受限。慢阻肺的危险因素可概括为GETomics，即遗传基因(G)、环境因素(E)及全生命期事件(T)，其中吸烟是最重要的环境暴露因素。慢阻肺的发病机制涉及气道炎症、氧化应激、细胞凋亡和组织重塑等多种病理生理过程。其中，肺血管内皮功能障碍被认为是慢阻肺发病的关键病理生理机制，主要表现为内皮细胞(endothelial cells，ECs)凋亡及血管结构的改变，这些改变可能促使肺血管重塑并引起肺动脉高压。内皮祖细胞(endothelial progenitor cells，EPCs)是一类骨髓来源的具有自我更新和定向分化潜能的细胞，在病理生理情况下被动员到外周血中，定向归巢到血管损伤区域发挥内皮修复作用。EPCs在慢阻肺的病理进程中具有重要作用。本文通过对EPCs的生物学功能及其在慢阻肺中的研究现状进行综述，旨在为慢阻肺等慢性肺部疾病的治疗提供新的思路。 EPCs的表型、鉴定及生物学功能 自Asahara等[1]在1997年首次报道外周血含有能够形成成熟ECs并具有血管新生能力的EPCs以来，EPCs在血管相关器官及疾病中的重要作用逐渐受到广泛关注。EPSs是一种源于骨髓的独特细胞亚型，其特性与胚胎造血细胞相似。这些细胞具有增殖和分化为成熟ECs的潜力，也被称为血管前体细胞[2-3]。EPCs可以被CD34、CD133和血管内皮生长因子受体(vascular endothelial growth factor receptor，VEGFR)2(在人体被称为KDR，小鼠中称为Flk-1)等表面标志物标记，通过流式细胞术或免疫荧光等技术手段进行识别[4-5]。EPCs可以从外周血、骨髓、脐带血、胎儿肝和淋巴管等多种来源中分离[6-10]。EPCs的培养通常采用外周血或骨髓单个核细胞进行体外诱导，并用对乙酰化低密度脂蛋白(acetelyated low density lipoprotein，AcLDL)和荆豆凝集素1(ulex europeaus agglutinin-1，UEA-1)的荧光染色双阳性对EPCs进行鉴定[4]。同时，体外培养的EPCs具有成管能力[11]。根据培养时间的长短，EPCs可以分为早期和晚期2种类型[5]：早期EPCs通常是指在体外培养7~10 d的细胞，具有有限的细胞增殖能力但较强的促血管生成和旁分泌活性；晚期EPCs则是指体外培养3周后的细胞，展示出较高的增殖潜力但无分泌活性。EPCs通过响应多种细胞因子、趋化因子、酶、配体和表面抗原的调节，从骨髓被招募、动员入血液循环，并归巢到受损的内皮部位以发挥其血管生成功能[12-16]。然而，关于EPCs的具体的迁移途径和信号通路，在外周循环中维持祖细胞特性以及其定位和归巢机制等方面，仍需进一步探索[17-22]。 EPCs在慢阻肺中的变化 在慢性气道疾病的病理进程中，缺氧环境被认为是动员骨髓EPCs并促进血管新生的关键因素，以期改善组织缺氧状态[23-26]。Peinado等[27]在对重度吸烟的慢阻肺患者进行研究时发现，其肺动脉中存在内皮损伤及CD133+细胞聚集，且这些细胞定位于成熟ECs附近，提示缺氧状态下祖细胞参与内皮修复过程。笔者的课题组的研究[28]和国外研究[29]均提示，与健康对照组外周血中的EPCs相比，稳定期慢阻肺患者的外周血中EPCs比例明显降低，且这种下调伴随着ECs集落的形成能力减弱、增殖能力下降以及体外一氧化氮分泌能力减弱。Salter等[30]发现慢阻肺患者血液中的EPCs数量约为健康对照者的十分之一，而其痰液中EPCs则显著增多，这表明慢阻肺患者体内的EPCs可能通过痰液被排出体外。也有学者[31]认为吸烟者和慢阻肺患者外周血EPCs存在细胞衰老表型及凋亡增加可能是外周血EPCs减少的原因。虽然一些研究结果存在差异，但是更多的临床研究支持慢阻肺患者外周血中EPCs数量减少的观点[32-39]。 在慢阻肺的不同严重程度和疾病阶段下，EPCs的数量和功能会呈现显著变化[31, 35, 38, 40-41]。研究团队[42]通过对61例慢阻肺患者与32名年龄、性别及吸烟指数匹配的健康对照者的大样本分析发现，慢阻肺患者的EPCs数量显著下调，且数量与第1秒用力呼气容积(forced expiratory volume in one second，FEV1)及FEV1占肺总量比值(forced expiratory volume in one second to forced vital capacity ratio，FEV1/FVC)呈正相关，进一步证实了气流受限的严重程度与EPCs数量呈负相关。研究团队[43]根据肺功能结果将研究参与者分为阻塞性通气功能障碍、限制性通气功能障碍与健康对照3组，对其外周血EPCs进行流式细胞分析，并结合血气分析等临床数据进行研究。结果显示，长期低氧环境下、重度阻塞性或弥散功能障碍的患者EPCs数量显著降低；此外，将血常规结果纳入分析后发现EPCs数量与红细胞计数直接相关，提示在慢性肺部疾病、长期缺氧患者中EPCs数量有显著下降。疾病严重程度越重、肺气肿程度越高的慢阻肺患者(尤其是小叶中央型肺气肿)，外周血EPCs数量越少[33-39]。这些发现强调了EPCs在不同严重程度的慢阻肺中的重要性，但仍需要在更大样本量的研究中进行进一步的验证与探讨。 研究[44-45]发现因慢阻肺急性加重而住院的患者，其循环EPCs的比例显著高于稳定期慢阻肺患者及吸烟人群，且外周血中高敏C反应蛋白和血管内皮生长因子(vascular endothelial growth factor，VEGF)的浓度和外周血EPCs比例呈正相关，一定程度上解释了慢阻肺急性加重的患者外周血EPCs数量增多的原因。此外，长期处于慢性缺氧状态的患者，其外周血中EPCs的数量明显高于非缺氧患者[43]，这表明患者的缺氧程度和氧合状态可能影响EPCs从骨髓到外周血的动员[33]。Huertas等[46]对39例中至重度慢阻肺患者[其中包括18例低体重指数(body mass index，BMI)和21例正常BMI的患者]和12例健康对照者进行研究，发现在肺功能相似的慢阻肺患者中，低BMI的亚组外周血中EPCs的细胞绝对数目明显减少，体外ECs集落的形成能力也大大减弱，这提示营养状况可能也参与了慢阻肺中EPCs减少的发病过程。在慢阻肺合并代谢综合征的人群中，EPCs有作为二者共患病标志物和治疗靶点的潜在价值[47]。慢阻肺患者运动训练后外周血中EPCs数量减少，可能是因为更多的EPCs归巢到了肺部[48]。 综上所述，在慢阻肺的疾病进程中，可能存在短期缺氧情况下EPCs功能障碍、代偿性数量上调[49]，而到了晚期出现失代偿的现象，EPCs表现出功能障碍且数量减少。随着气流阻塞、肺气肿的加剧或合并症、全身情况的改变，EPCs的数量越来越少。 慢阻肺中EPCs变化的机制 在慢阻肺中，EPCs数量的减少可能与多种机制相关，主要包括以下科学假说：骨髓产生与释放EPCs的功能受损、血管招募功能障碍、祖细胞凋亡增加、成管相关因子表达差异及细胞衰老等[31, 50]。 绝大多数假说均指向EPCs的产生、动员及功能改变的病理生理过程。多项研究[46, 50-52]显示，VEGF等促血管生成因子在多种疾病模型中均可以促进EPCs动员，参与新生血管生成的调节。VEGF可以通过VEGFR参与细胞的增殖、分化、存活等多种生物学过程[50-51]。肺动脉的免疫组织化学研究[52]显示，吸烟者和中度慢阻肺患者的VEGF表达水平增加，而在严重肺气肿的肺组织中VEGF水平则降低，提示VEGF的表达水平与慢阻肺的严重程度相关，并可能参与血管重塑过程。此外，低BMI的人群血浆中血管内皮生长因子A(vascular endothelial growth factor A，VEGFA)、血管内皮生长因子C(vascular endothelial growth factor C，VEGFC)、干细胞生长因子(stem cell growth factor，SCF)、肿瘤坏死因子(tumor necrosis factor，TNF)、白细胞介素-6(interleukin-6，IL-6)、血管生成素-1(angiopoietin-1，Ang-1)、单核细胞趋化蛋白-1(monocyte chemoattractant protein-1，MCP-1)等因子的表达水平较正常BMI的患者增高[46]。这些发现提示多种细胞因子可能参与慢阻肺中EPCs变化的病理生理过程，这些变化可能与疾病的严重程度、氧合状态、患者的营养状况等多种因素有关[46]。 趋化因子12(chemokine C-X-C motif ligand 12，CXCL12)是趋化因子家族的成员，在祖细胞的动员过程中尤其是骨髓中CD34+细胞的动员中发挥重要作用，是首个被报道的祖细胞趋化因子[53]。趋化因子受体4(chemokine C-X-C motif receptor 4，CXCR4)是CXCL12的特异性配体，其同EPCs显示出一致的变化模式，表明CXCL12及其受体CXCR4在祖细胞的迁移和功能中扮演重要角色[30]。在体外培养的慢阻肺患者外周血EPCs中，CXCR4的表达显著下调[54]。CXCL12/CXCR4信号轴可能是骨髓祖细胞动员的关键通路之一[55]。在慢阻肺模型小鼠中也观察到骨髓微环境中CXCL12/CXCR4通路表达的明显降低，进一步证明了此通路在慢阻肺病理过程中的关键作用[56]。 pmc-12415088.title: Multimodal Psychobehavioral Interventions for Lung Cancer–Related Pain: A Protocol Development and Validation Study Examining the Mediating Role of Self-Efficacy in the Relationship Between Pain Perception and Adaptive Coping Strategies
pmc-12415088.creator: Bing Liu, Yongyong Ding, Junfei Xu, Xuehai Wu, Xiaofeng Yang, Yi Liu, Hong Deng
pmc-12415088.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the effects of a comprehensive intervention program on cancer pain and self-efficacy in patients with lung cancer.MethodsA total of 120 lung cancer patients with cancer pain who received treatment from January 2021 to December 2023 at The First People’s Hospital of Zunyi were enrolled in this study.

pmc-12438944.title: Deep Anterior Lamellar Keratoplasty Versus Penetrating Keratoplasty in Keratoconus: A Retrospective Study Using Coarsened Exact Matching
pmc-12438944.creator: Farid Karimian, Kiana Hassanpour, Farbod Semnani, Sepehr Feizi, Mohammad Ali Javadi, Amir Faramarzi, Mohammadreza Jafarinasab
pmc-12438944.description: PurposeTo compare the graft survival rates and visual outcomes in patients with keratoconus (KCN) undergoing deep anterior lamellar keratoplasty (DALK) versus penetrating keratoplasty (PKP) and identify possible risk factors.MethodsThis retrospective longitudinal study enrolled patients with KCN who underwent corneal transplantation at Labbafinejad Medical Center (Tehran, Iran) between 2006 and 2016. We utilized a one-to-one coarsened exact matching (CEM) approach.

pmc-12446000.title: Temporal regulation of genetic programs governing multiple cell death during myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury
pmc-12446000.creator: Qiuyu Pang, Xiangmin Meng, Zhenfang Zhou, Lu You, Jinghan Yuan, Qipu Feng, Bingmei Zhu
pmc-12446000.description: IntroductionReperfusion serves as an effective therapeutic strategy for myocardial infarction (MI), but it causes damage to the heart. Although many studies have investigated the mechanism of disparate forms of cell death in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (I/R), there remains a paucity of studies focus on the direct comparison of the mode of cell death events resulting from different reperfusion periods.

pmc-12691433.title: Atypical Teratoid Rhabdoid Tumor: How Tumor Diagnostic Methods in the Laboratory Have Evolved over the Past 40 Years
pmc-12691433.creator: Heather L Smith, Pascale Aouad, Nitin R Wadhwani, David Eisenstat
pmc-12691433.description: Simple SummaryThis opinion article examines the historical evolution of laboratory-based tumor diagnostic methods over the past four decades, with a detailed light microscopic characterization of Atypical Teratoid/Rhabdoid Tumor across both typical and challenging presentations. It also includes time points of importance where the spectrum of immunohistochemical and molecular alterations have changed for the pathologic diagnosis of Atypical Teratoid/Rhabdoid Tumor.

pmc-12992781.title: Pedunculopontine-thalamic cholinergic projections in rapid eye movement sleep behaviour disorder
pmc-12992781.creator: Julia Schumacher, Stefan Teipel, Alexander Storch, Wiebke Hermann
pmc-12992781.description: Cholinergic system degeneration is a hallmark of Lewy body disease, including Parkinson’s disease (PD) and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB), but its involvement in prodromal stages, particularly regarding pedunculopontine-thalamic projections, remains unclear. This study investigated cholinergic pathway integrity in isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder (iRBD) and its relation to phenoconversion risk.

pmc-13111741.title: A differential single-cell transcriptome atlas of left-sided and right-sided colorectal cancer
pmc-13111741.creator: Chengzhi Zhao, Weiye Zhou, Guangjian Zeng, Yeen Huang, Chuan Shi, Haibei Ma, Yang Li, Jiachun Lv, Xiaohua Liang, Shenying Fang
pmc-13111741.description: Left-sided colorectal cancer (LCRC) and right-sided colorectal cancer (RCRC) show marked differences in prognosis and therapeutic response, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. We hypothesize that these clinical differences reflect distinct cell-type-specific transcriptional programs and microenvironmental interactions that can be resolved at single-cell resolution.

pmc-13186198.title: Malocclusion traits and oral health-related quality of life in adolescents: a multicenter cross-sectional study
pmc-13186198.creator: Emma Göranson, Lillemor Dimberg, Aron Naimi-Akbar, Mikael Sonesson
pmc-13186198.description: AimThis study aimed to examine associations between separate malocclusion traits and oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL) among adolescents with malocclusion. It also aimed to assess sex differences in OHRQoL and whether sex modified the associations between malocclusion traits and OHRQoL.MethodsWe conducted a multicenter cross-sectional study among adolescents aged 12–19 years.

pmc-13194210.title: Integrative Intelligence as an Operative Mode: Cognitive Integration through Self-Ethnographic Dialogue with AI
pmc-13194210.creator: Masaki Iino
pmc-13194210.description: This paper proposes Integrative Intelligence as an operative mode of human judgment in which temporal integration (past–present–future), contextual integration (roles, relationships, life domains), and embodied integration (body, emotion, thought, meaning-making) function simultaneously without fragmentation. It is not introduced as a new ability or developmental stage but as a mode already latent in ordinary judgment that becomes legible under particular conditions.

pmc-13199576.title: Age-grading and species identification of male mosquito Anopheles gambiae s.l. using mid-infrared spectroscopy and machine learning
pmc-13199576.creator: Roger Sanou, Emmanuel P. Mwanga, Bazoumana B. D. Sow, Hamidou Maïga, François Wiminga, Doreen Josen Siria, Adrien Marie Gaston Belem, Roch K. Dabiré, Klaas Wynne, Heather M. Ferguson, Mario González-Jiménez, Simon A. Babayan, Fredros O. Okumu, Francesco Baldini, Abdoulaye Diabaté
pmc-13199576.description: Most malaria vector control strategies target female Anopheles mosquitoes that transmit parasites, but emerging approaches such as gene drive, sterile insect technique, or Wolbachia require the release of males. Successful deployment depends on reliable knowledge of the species composition and age structure of male populations to overcome potential barriers to mating.

pmc-13323346.title: Metabolic - Bariatric Surgery in Elderly Patients – Safety and Effectiveness in a Single-Center Cohort
pmc-13323346.creator: Lea Pedarnig, Julia Jedamzik, Larissa Nixdorf, Paula Richwien, Magdalena Mairinger, Christoph Bichler, Felix Benedikt Langer, Lisa Gensthaler, Michael Krebs, Gerhard Prager, Daniel Moritz Felsenreich
pmc-13323346.description: IntroductionOverweight and obesity have been steadily increasing worldwide. Metabolic/bariatric surgery (MBS) is the most effective treatment for obesity and its associated medical conditions. Obesity complications increase with age, however, older patients face a higher perioperative risk necessitating a clear risk-benefit balance.

pmc-13391545.title: Waste to wealth: circular approaches for microbial pigment production
pmc-13391545.creator: Moitrayee Devi, Arnabjyoti Deva Sarma, Suresh Deka, Rajashree Bhattacharyya, Deep Prakash Parasar
pmc-13391545.description: The increasing demand for natural and sustainable colorants has accelerated interest in microbial pigments as alternatives to synthetic dyes. Diverse microorganisms, including bacteria, fungi, yeasts, microalgae, and actinomycetes, produce pigments such as carotenoids, melanins, prodigiosin, violacein, and phycobiliproteins with applications in food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, textiles, and biomedicine.

pmc-13457472.title: Culture-based inventory and functional guild analysis of root-invading fungi associated with grassland plants across multiple regions in China
pmc-13457472.creator: Tong Tong Wang, Bo Yang, Yue Yang Zhang, Hua Qi Liu, Long Bing Zhang, Yan Zhong Li

pmc-13629088.title: Comparison of the cytotoxic and apoptotic effects of mouthwashes containing different active ingredients on human gingival fibroblasts and their antimicrobial efficacy
pmc-13629088.creator: Tuğba Yıldırım, Arife Kaptan, Ceylan Özsoy, Tutku Tunç
pmc-13629088.description: BackgroundThe use of biocompatible materials on oral tissues is important for maintaining tissue health. Therefore, this study compared, in vitro, the antimicrobial effects of seven different mouthwashes (BenriDent, Listerine Total Care, Splat White Plus, Dkdent, Klorhex, Oral-B, Colgate Plax) containing various active ingredients, as well as their apoptotic and cytotoxic effects on human gingival fibroblast (hGF) cells and DNA damage.
